name: CED Boise
about:
CED Boise operates from Boise, Idaho, as a branch of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national electrical distribution network founded in 1957. The Boise location has served the Treasure Valley for more than two decades, providing electrical products and services to local contractors and industrial customers.

The company distributes electrical equipment from manufacturers such as ABB and Siemens, and offers project management, lighting design and quotations, lighting control systems, and gear quotations. Its Stage n' Store service includes an 18,000-square-foot bonded and insured warehouse with 24/7 surveillance, supported by multiple delivery trucks running daily routes throughout the region.

CED Boise serves commercial and residential electrical contractors, industrial automation firms, agricultural operations, government agencies, utilities, and industrial maintenance and repair organizations.

The branch emphasizes a "Service, Integrity, Reliability" philosophy, combining local decision-making with the resources of a national network. Its Stage n' Store solution is designed to manage project orders from receipt through final delivery, with email and text notifications for pickup and delivery.

name: CED Twin State Electric Supply
old_description: Our service first philosophy has served us well over the past 70 years we've been in business.
about:
CED Twin State Electric Supply, operating as CED Barre, has served the Barre, Vermont area for over 70 years from its location on Industrial Lane. The company describes itself as an electrical supplier with a service-first philosophy, though it does not disclose a specific founding year or ownership structure.

The business functions as a distributor of electrical materials, stocking products from brands such as Kichler Lighting, Square D switchgear, and Milwaukee and Diablo tools. Beyond distribution, it provides a suite of value-added services: custom lighting design (ambient, task, and accent), value-engineered lighting packages, vendor-managed inventory with barcoded 5S organization and weekly on-site replenishment, custom panel schedules, custom gear builds ranging from AC disconnects to switchboards, fluorescent tube recycling, network sourcing through the national CED network, and a tool-loaning program that includes jack stands and crimpers.

Its customer base includes commercial lighting specifiers, residential contractors, homeowners, and electrical contractors who need materials, design support, or pre-assembled gear. The company highlights its ability to support commercial specified lighting projects and residential installs with same-day access to in-stock fixtures.

CED Barre emphasizes integrity—owning mistakes and preventing recurrence—and reliability through communication and consistency. Its national CED affiliation allows next-day delivery on many items via UPS Red Label, and accounts gain access to Square D special pricing agreements.

name: CH America
old_description: Injection Molding Machines with Precision Performance and Energy Savings!
about:
CH America, based in Torrington, Connecticut, was formed as a joint venture between Plastics One of Torrington, CT, and Machinery International of Detroit, MI, to bring the Chen Hsong line of injection molding machines to the North American market. The company operates a 40,000-square-foot corporate office and warehouse in Torrington, supplemented by several warehousing locations nationwide.

CH America sells, services, and supports Chen Hsong injection molding machines, including the JM-MK6, SM DPV, Spark EH electric, SMV, Focus 60 SVP/2, and Supermaster two-platen servo-drive series, with clamping forces from 80 to 6,500 tons. The company also supplies auxiliary equipment such as robots, grinders, dryers, feeding and conveying systems, and chillers. An experienced engineering and service management team—four veterans with over 50 years of combined senior-management experience—handles machine start-up, preventive maintenance, and repair for all installed Chen Hsong machines across the U.S. and Canada.

The company serves the plastics injection molding industry, targeting molders and manufacturers seeking energy-efficient, high-performance machines. A testimonial from Mina Product Development Co. Inc. illustrates its customer base. CH America’s machines feature integrated hot-runner and valve-gate controls, gas-assist and accumulated injection capabilities, and specialized configurations for rigid UPVC production.

CH America differentiates itself with a fully customized in-house control system built on Beckhoff servo controllers, Industry 4.0 readiness via cloud-based monitoring and IoT connectivity, and stock machines available for inspection at its Torrington and Detroit facilities. The venture was created to provide local sales, service, and support for a global machine builder, combining Chinese manufacturing scale with North American service infrastructure.

name: CI-DELL Plastics, Inc.
old_description: People come to us for precision thermoset molding and machining.
about:
CI-Dell Plastics, Inc. is based in Mequon, Wisconsin. Founded by Ken Cihlar, the company has spent nearly 40 years specializing in precision thermoset molding and machining.

The shop offers a range of thermoset capabilities including compression and injection molding of phenolic, polyester, bulk molding compound (BMC), and sheet molding compound (SMC) materials. It also provides in-house tool room services, CNC machining of plastics, preforming, pelletizing, assembly, kitting, and plaque production.

CI-Dell serves the automotive industry with components such as valve covers, headlight liners, ignition parts, caps, and housings. It also supplies parts for small and major appliances, electrical components, and has had its specifications approved by the U.S. Department of Defense for use by the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

The company emphasizes operational excellence through teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification and individual employee certifications. Its approach centers on personal collaboration, creative problem-solving, and a commitment to on-time delivery.

name: CKC Automation
old_description: UL 508A control panel and electrical subsystem contract manufacturer
about:
CKC Automation was founded in 2005 in Benicia, California, as a multidisciplinary engineering and manufacturing partner specializing in industrial automation. The company operates from a single integrated facility in the Bay Area, combining machine design, controls engineering, data systems, and UL 508A-certified control panel fabrication under one roof.

The firm’s core offerings span three pillars: custom machine design-build, including robotic work cells and build-to-print equipment; high-volume contract manufacturing of control panels and electrical subsystems from its UL 508A panel shop; and controls and data services that collect, analyze, and visualize production data for real-time decision making. Its Benicia facility houses engineering offices, a certified panel shop, assembly space, and testing and validation areas, enabling close collaboration between design and build teams.

CKC serves manufacturers across the Bay Area and West Coast, delivering end-to-end automation solutions from concept through commissioning. While the company does not publicly list specific verticals, its case studies and client references indicate work with manufacturers seeking to optimize throughput, quality, and efficiency.

The company emphasizes a “right-sized” model that blends Silicon Valley innovation with engineering standards, offering local responsiveness and end-to-end partnership.

name: CSM Fabricators
old_description: Founded in 2018 Custom Sheet Metal Fabricators (CSM Fabricators) was born from two beliefs:
about:
CSM Fabricators was founded in 2018 in Oakland Park, Florida, born from two convictions: the need to fill a gap in the market for quality sheet metal work and a desire to support the roofing community across South Florida. The company operates from two facilities, one in Oakland Park and a second in West Palm Beach (Mangonia Park), serving as a dedicated fabrication partner for roofing professionals.

The shop specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication for roofing components, producing standing seam metal roof panels, architectural copper pieces, coping caps, custom trim packages, door and window pans, goosenecks, roof vents, gutters, and a range of other metal roofing accessories. Its capabilities include precision sheet metal fabrication, architectural standing seam panel manufacturing, and professional takeoff services for project estimation. The company emphasizes its ES-1 certified shop, state-of-the-art fabrication equipment, and a team experienced in delivering products to exact specifications.

CSM Fabricators serves commercial and residential roofing contractors as well as general contractors throughout South Florida. Customers include roofing companies needing custom roof drain scuppers, chimney caps, full metal roof systems, flashing, and drip edge, with the shop providing on-demand fabrication for projects of any size.

The company distinguishes itself through its ES-1 certification, fully licensed and insured status, and a focus on quick turnaround enabled by modern equipment. It positions itself as an end-to-end sheet metal fabrication partner, offering takeoff services, custom fabrication, and direct delivery to job sites.

about:
CT Furniture Restoration operates from a workshop in Stratford, Connecticut, serving Fairfield County and clients nationwide. The business grew from the career of lead artisan Luis Solano, who began restoring furniture in 2000 at Maurice Villency before establishing his own shop. While the company's exact founding year is not stated, Solano's two decades of experience form the foundation of its craftsmanship.

The workshop provides a full spectrum of furniture services: upholstery and reupholstery for antique, vintage, and modern pieces; wood refinishing including French polishing, custom staining, and structural frame repair; leather and vinyl restoration with color re-dyeing and patching; and custom furniture manufacturing. The latter includes bespoke fabrication for interior designers, architectural woodworking, millwork support, and CAD-to-build execution. The facility handles pickup and delivery across Connecticut and coordinates insured nationwide shipping.

Clients range from homeowners and collectors to interior designers, architects, and commercial accounts. Trade professionals receive dedicated workroom services with trade pricing, project management, and fast-track scheduling. Projects cited include mid-century modern restorations (Danish chairs, teak credenzas), vintage executive desk refurbishment, and custom dining tables, credenzas, and upholstered seating built to specification for luxury residential and commercial interiors.

Solano emphasizes a deep respect for craftsmanship and timeless design, describing each piece as a story to be honored through meticulous detail. The company positions its work as preserving original beauty while ensuring functionality, a philosophy that extends from heirloom restoration to new custom builds.
